description: Extend @oxagen/functions types with timeouts and onFailure support, then implement a createFunction adapter in @oxagen/inngest-functions that wraps abstract DurableFunction definitions into Inngest-native functions.
steps: 1. In packages/functions/src/types.ts, add `timeouts?: { finish?: string }` to the DurableFunctionConfig interface (used by agent.video-render with '16m').

2. In packages/functions/src/types.ts, add an `onFailure?: DurableFunctionHandler` field to DurableFunctionConfig. This allows defining failure handlers inline rather than as separate functions. The adapter will register them as companion Inngest functions.

3. In packages/functions/src/types.ts, add a `createFunction` factory function type/signature: `export type CreateFunctionFactory = (config: DurableFunctionConfig, trigger: DurableFunctionTrigger, handler: DurableFunctionHandler) => DurableFunction;`
4. Export the new types from packages/functions/src/index.ts.
5. Add type-level tests in packages/functions/src/types.test.ts verifying timeouts and onFailure fields compile correctly and createFunction factory signature is callable.

6. Create packages/inngest-functions/src/create-function.ts implementing the adapter. It should: (a) accept (config: DurableFunctionConfig, trigger: DurableFunctionTrigger, handler: DurableFunctionHandler) and return a DurableFunction[], (b) call inngest.createFunction() internally converting abstract config/trigger to Inngest format, (c) wrap the handler to translate StepContext from Inngest's step object, (d) if config.onFailure is set, register a companion inngest.createFunction for 'inngest/function.failed' with the appropriate if-filter, (e) handle NonRetriableError translation: catch the @oxagen/functions NonRetriableError in the wrapper and re-throw Inngest's native NonRetriableError so runtime instanceof checks work.

7. The adapter's step wrapper must map: step.run -> inngest step.run, step.sendEvent -> inngest step.sendEvent, step.waitForEvent -> inngest step.waitForEvent, step.sleep -> inngest step.sleep. All with the same label/name semantics.
8. Export createFunction from packages/inngest-functions/src/adapter.ts (or a new dedicated file) and from the package's index.ts and 'adapter' export path.

9. Add unit tests for createFunction adapter in packages/inngest-functions/src/create-function.test.ts: verify it produces correct Inngest function calls, verify onFailure companion is registered, verify NonRetriableError translation, verify step methods are proxied correctly.
acceptance_criteria: packages/functions types include timeouts and onFailure in DurableFunctionConfig
A createFunction adapter exists in @oxagen/inngest-functions that accepts abstract definitions and returns provider-native function objects
The adapter correctly translates StepContext methods (run, sendEvent, waitForEvent, sleep)
The adapter generates companion on-failure functions when config.onFailure is provided
NonRetriableError from @oxagen/functions is caught and re-thrown as Inngest SDK NonRetriableError in the adapter wrapper
pnpm typecheck passes in both packages/functions and packages/inngest-functions
pnpm test:unit passes in both packages
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Types extended with timeouts and onFailure. createFunction adapter implemented and exported from both adapter.ts and index.ts. 26 tests pass in packages/functions (3 new). 259 tests pass in packages/inngest-functions (21 in create-function.test.ts). Full monorepo typecheck (30 packages) passes via pre-commit hook. Review fix applied: on-failure companion now uses minimal { id } config instead of inheriting primary's retries/concurrency/cancelOn/timeouts. Companion DurableFunction.config no longer spreads the primary config (including onFailure handler reference).
